build.name: dev
build.summary: start the local WordPress site and rebuild on change

build.name: dev stop
build.summary: stop the local site, keeping its data

build.name: build
build.summary: write the WordPress plugins to first/dist/wp-content

build.name: check
build.summary: compile and report problems; write nothing

build.name: add
build.summary: add a module to the project as files you own; never overwrites one. Modules: db (SQL tables)

build.name: doctor
build.summary: check a build, and a running site (FIRST_TOKEN)

build.name: init
build.summary: write AGENTS.md, .mcp.json and the agent skills for this project; --check exits 1 when they are out of date

build.name: mcp
build.summary: serve the project to a coding agent as an MCP server on stdio

build.name: sync
build.summary: content files <-> site records (FIRST_APP_PASSWORD or FIRST_TOKEN)

build.name: pull
build.summary: write a site's runtime schema versions to first/_generated/runtime-schema.json (FIRST_APP_PASSWORD or FIRST_TOKEN)

build.name: abilities pull
build.summary: lock a site's abilities into first/_generated/abilities.json (FIRST_APP_PASSWORD)

site.name: wp
site.summary: any WP-CLI command (first wp plugin list)

site.name: migrate
site.summary: apply pending database migrations, checked against live rows

site.name: jobs
site.args: list [--state=s] | run <id> | retry <id> | cancel <id> | maintain | tick [--limit=n] [--budget-ms=ms]

site.name: schema
site.summary: the site's runtime schema versions (runtimeSchema: true)

site.name: action
site.summary: call an action as the trusted CLI

site.name: publish-due
site.summary: publish scheduled records that are due

site.name: staged
site.summary: staged versions of post kinds: list, stage, compare, promote, discard

site.name: identity
site.args: account|suspend|restore|revoke|erase <user-id> | app add --name=n --redirect=uri --origin=o [--id=app_id] | agent add <user> --name=n [--write] [--personal] [--abilities=a,b] | agent list <user> | agent grant <user> <id> [--write] [--personal] [--abilities=a,b] | agent revoke <user> <id> | webhook-add <url> | webhook-remove <id> | webhooks | maintenance | rotate-keys
site.summary: First Identity accounts, applications, agent credentials, webhooks and keys

site.name: migrate-legacy
site.summary: move content from an original Zero site

site.name: migrate-legacy-users
site.summary: move an original Zero site's users
